title: Questions 155-157 refer to the following advertisement.
passage_1:
Take Control of Your Stock with ShelfSense

Is counting your inventory by hand wearing you out? ShelfSense is the ideal answer for shop owners and workshop managers who find stock control confusing. It is a safe, cloud-based system that sorts your incoming and outgoing goods so that you can produce clear reorder reports in one click.

New Feature Alert:

Four months ago, we released the Quick Count tool. This tool automatically marks likely shortages and mistakes in your counts. Since its release, it has become a favorite among our users, saving them hours of manual checking.

Plans & Pricing:

For single-location shops, the Basic Plan is ideal. However, for growing businesses with several branches, we suggest the Network Plan, which includes warehouse tracking and multiuser access.

Special Offer:

Sign up by November 30 to enjoy a 45-day free trial of any plan. Visit www.shelfsense.com today.
